urdu: دار العلوم فیض الرسول کی قیادت کون فرما رہے ہیں؟
english: Who is leading Darul Uloom Faizur Rasul?
roman_1: Darul Uloom Faizur Rasul ki qiadat kaun farma rahe hain?
roman_2: Darul Uloom Faizur Rasul ki qiyadat kon farma rahe hain?
roman_3: Darul Uloom Faizur Rasul ki qayadat kon farma rahe hain?
